name: Chikan Circle ~Kaikan Rush Hour Sesshoku Hen~
original_name: 痴漢サークル～快感ラッシュアワー・接触篇～
source:
Junichi is an average university student. He doesn't have a girlfriend, but enjoys his school life with his close friend, Yui. One day, he finds a girl groping a man's body when he is on the train. Train molester...? The girl keeps groping and the man finally ejaculates.... Is that a dream...? On the next day, when he gets on the crowded train, he finds the girl. The girl suddenly starts groping his body and he soon ejaculates.... Her name is Ai and recruits him into her circle called the "Chikan (molestation) Circle", which includes members who want to molest or be molested. Junichi is interested in Ai herself, so he decides to join it. However, he needs to pass the test to join the circle. The test is to recruit a girl, in other words, to molest a girl who wants to be molested and make her understand the pleasure of being molested.... Junichi's target girl is Yui.... He hesitates at first, but he, who is addicted to Chikan, makes up his mind to take the test. Like this, his Chikan life starts....

translation:
纯一是一名普通大学生。虽然没有女朋友，却与好友由衣一同享受着校园生活。一天，他在电车上看见一名少女抚摸一名男子的身体。女痴汉…？少女不断抚摸，男子最终射精…这是梦吗…？第二天，纯一登上拥挤的电车，又看见了那名少女。她突然开始抚摸他的身体，纯一很快也射了出来…少女名叫爱，并邀请他加入自己的“痴汉社团”。社团成员都是想猥亵他人或希望遭到猥亵的人。纯一对爱本人很感兴趣，于是决定加入。然而，他必须先通过入社测试：招募一名少女，换言之，就是猥亵一个希望被猥亵的少女，让她体会其中的快感…纯一的目标是由衣…起初他有所犹豫，但已经沉迷于痴汉行为的他最终决定接受测试。就这样，纯一的痴汉生活开始了…
